translation:
The saying goes, "Ghosts are no more than
withered silver grass,” right?

It means that when you're scared, everything
looks suspicious.
I bet that happens to you a lot, huh?
Eek… I guess so.
So, what's your point?

Well Koizumi told me that the world's unnatural
phenomena are just made up…

Sure thing—like how the famous photo of the
Loch Ness Monster was revealed to be fake.

I think there're lots of nonsense rumors out
there.

Then, things like ghosts don't exist either,
right?
Who knows?

B-but, aren't they just withered silver
grass?
What's withered silver grass?

It's what you get when the tips of Chinese
silver grass wither away.
Grass is ghosts?

If you're expecting a ghost to appear, even
grass might look like one.
I don't see it—grass is grass!

You wouldn't see it. You're not a scaredy-cat
after all.
Nope!

Ehh—am I the only one that's scared enough
to start seeing things?

Baseless rumors and seeing things, I think
that's actually pretty common.

But that's not 100% always the case. I believe
there are undiscovered mysteries as well.
I'd rather it be 100%, though…
That's what I call a boring life.
It's more fun to be scared as well, sometimes.
I don't think it's fun!

Really? A life of 100% safety and peace of
mind would be unbelievably boring, wouldn't it?
Excitement is important in life.

In that sense, you have the most exciting life
out of any of us, right?
Ehh? I do?

The greater the scaredy-cat, the more exci-
ting life is. It's a trait with valuable benefits.
I don't need that kind of benefit at all!
I'm starting to become a little jealous.
A little jealous!
Ehhh? No way!
